import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify feature columns (exclude id and species)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["species"].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = le.fit_transform(y)
n_classes = len(le.classes_)

# Stratified Train-Validation Split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_encoded
)

# Prepare LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Model parameters
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": n_classes,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train model
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Predict probabilities on validation set
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
# Calculate Log Loss on validation set
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_loss}")

# Predict probabilities on test set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission dataframe
# Ensure columns match sample_submission exactly
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_preds, columns=sample_submission.columns[1:])
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
